blocks.text: Lafz stoichiometry do Greek alfaaz se bana hai: stoicheion yani element, aur metron yani naap (measure). Is tarah stoichiometry ka matlab hai reactants aur products ki miqdar (quantity) ko naapna.

blocks.title: Stoichiometry
blocks.text: Stoichiometry (bolte hain: stoy-key-om-eh-tree) chemistry ki woh branch hai jis mein balanced chemical equation ke reactants aur products ki miqdaron (amounts) ka aapas mein taalluq (relationship) parha jata hai.

Balanced chemical equation mein har qism ke atoms dono taraf barabar hote hain. Is mein reactants aur products ek fixed ratio (tanasub) mein hote hain, bilkul jaise compound mein elements fixed ratio mein hote hain. Inhi ratios se doosre substances ka mass ya moles nikala jata hai.

Stoichiometry ke hisab do qanoon (laws) maante hain: law of conservation of mass aur law of definite proportions. Law of conservation of mass kehta hai ke “matter (mass) na banaya ja sakta hai na khatam kiya ja sakta hai”. Stoichiometry mein is ka matlab hai ke balanced equation mein reactants ka kul mass products ke kul mass ke barabar hota hai. Law of definite proportions kehta hai ke ek khalis (pure) compound mein elements hamesha mass ke ek hi ratio mein mile hote hain.
Mole ka tasawwur (concept)

blocks.title: Mole
blocks.text: Mole kisi substance ki woh miqdar hai jis mein utne hi bunyadi zarray (elementary entities) hon jitne 0.012 kg (12 g) carbon-12 mein atoms hote hain.

Yeh zarray atoms, molecules, ions, electrons ya doosre particles ho sakte hain. Mole ko n se likhte hain. Ek mole mein zarron ki tadaad ek fixed number hai jise Avogadro’s number kehte hain: 6.02 x 10²³. Ise Nₐ se likhte hain. Yeh qeemat Italian scientist Amedeo Avogadro (1776-1856) ke naam se hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein scientist ka naam “Amedo” chhapa hai; sahi naam Amedeo Avogadro hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Avogadro’s number ek physical constant hai jo ek mole mein zarron ki tadaad batata hai. Is ki poori qeemat 6.02214179 x 10²³ mol⁻¹ hai. Hisab mein hum round off qeemat 6.02 x 10²³ istemal karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein unit “mol⁻” chhapa hai, us ki power (1) reh gayi hai; sahi unit mol⁻¹ (fi mole) hai.
Misalein:

items: ¹²C ke 1 mole mein ¹²C ke 6.02 x 10²³ atoms hote hain.
H₂O ke 1 mole mein H₂O ke 6.02 x 10²³ molecules hote hain.
NaCl ke 1 mole mein NaCl ke 6.02 x 10²³ formula units hote hain.
Na⁺ ke 1 mole mein Na⁺ ke 6.02 x 10²³ ions hote hain.

blocks.text: Chemists atoms, molecules, formula units ya ions ko tolne aur ginne ke liye mole ko SI unit ke taur par istemal karte hain.

Kisi substance (element, compound ya ionic species) ke ek mole ka mass us ke atomic mass, molecular mass, formula mass ya ionic mass ke barabar hota hai jab use grams mein likha jaye. Ise molar mass kehte hain aur M se likhte hain.

blocks.title: Molar mass
blocks.text: Kisi substance ke ek mole ka mass, grams mein, us ka molar mass kehlata hai.
Molar mass ka unit g/mol hai. Molar mass us substance ke sab atoms ke masses ka jor (sum) hota hai.
CCl₄ ke ek mole ka mass nikalne ke liye carbon aur chlorine ke masses jama karte hain:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}\text{Molar mass of }\ce{CCl4} &= \text{Molar mass of one C} + \text{Molar mass of Cl} \times 4\\ &= 12.0 \times 1 + 35.5 \times 4\\ \text{Molar mass of }\ce{CCl4} &= 12.0 + 142.0 = 154.0\ \text{g}\end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: Molar mass of CCl₄ = Molar mass of one C + Molar mass of Cl x 4 = 12.0 x 1 + 35.5 x 4; Molar mass of CCl₄ = 12.0 + 142.0 = 154.0 g

blocks.text: Mazeed misalein

items: Carbon atoms ka 1 mole 12.0 g hai.
CO₂ molecules ka 1 mole 44.0 g hai.
CaO formula units ka 1 mole 56.1 g hai.
CO₃²⁻ ions ka 1 mole 60.0 g hai.

blocks.text: Kisi substance ke moles nikalne ke liye grams mein mass ko molar mass se divide karte hain. Formula yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: Number of moles = Given mass / Molar mass

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Mole ek “darjan” ki tarah ginti ka unit hai: 1 darjan = 12 cheezein, 1 mole = 6.02 x 10²³ zarray. Mass se moles: mass ÷ molar mass. Moles se mass: moles x molar mass.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.1
blocks.problem: 20 g NaOH mein kitne moles hain?
steps: Number of moles = given mass ÷ molar mass

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.2
steps: Mass = number of moles x molar mass

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Sample Problem 4.2 ka jawab “18.3 mol” likha hai. Sawal mass ka hai, is liye unit gram hoga: 0.5 x 36.5 = 18.25 g (taqreeban 18.3 g), “mol” nahi.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.3
steps: MgSO₄ ka molar mass = 24 + 96 = 120 g mol⁻¹ (Mg = 24, SO₄ = 32 + 4 x 16 = 96)

blocks.text: Quick Check 4.1

blocks.prompt: a) KMnO₄ ka molar mass nikalein.
b) 0.23 g sodium mein kitne moles hain?
c) 1.5 moles Ca(OH)₂ ka mass nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Ca(OH)₂ ka molar mass = 40 + 2 x 17 = 74 g/mol. Mass = 1.5 x 74 = 111 g.

blocks.prompt: d) KClO₃ ka diya hua mass 24.5 g hai. Potassium chlorate ke moles nikalein.
e) 1.75 g H₂O₂ mein kitne molecules hain?
blocks.explanation: H₂O₂ = 2 + 32 = 34 g/mol. n = 1.75 ÷ 34 = 0.0515 mol. Molecules = 0.0515 x 6.02 x 10²³ = 3.1 x 10²² molecules.

blocks.prompt: f) 15 g sone (gold) ki anguthi mein kitne atoms hain?

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Stoichiometry balanced equation se reactants aur products ki miqdar naapti hai; yeh law of conservation of mass aur law of definite proportions par chalti hai.
1 mole = 12 g carbon-12 jitne zarray = 6.02 x 10²³ (Nₐ).
Molar mass M = ek mole ka mass grams mein (CCl₄ = 154.0 g); n = m ÷ M.
